title: Locked 3D Click Deselects Like Background
description: Bug in 3D: when an item is locked and it is clicked it should be equivalent to clicking background. e.g. when in puzzle 3d clicking on a locked reference it should deselect everything.
summary: Locked 3D entities no longer absorb canvas picks. Shared world layer uses selectable (not inspectable) for reference/volume raycasts so locked clicks pass through like background and fire deselect. Puzzle objects emit disabled when locked; instance picks and worldPick treat locked hits as clear-selection. Covered by worldEntityFlags vitest + world_pick_locked_object_clears_like_background.
